invariants.rationale: The method immediately calls skin.getDrawable(drawableName), so a non-null skin is necessary to avoid a NullPointerException.
Passing a null name to skin.getDrawable may result in an error or not locate a drawable; ensuring non-null is likely a precondition.
The method assumes skin contains a mapping for drawableName to a Drawable for correct operation.
The method passes the result of getDrawable(drawableName) to setDrawable, likely expecting a non-null Drawable.
Drawable names are likely expected to be non-empty; passing an empty string may not reference a valid Drawable.
